rv.q: The opera is a triumph of drama on every level.
Kaija Saariaho's 'Innocence,' one of the most important new operas of this century, finally made it to the Metropolitan Opera on Monday in a superb performance.
Despite its beauty and power, the Met’s Innocence had me wanting to run.

cn.t: Saariaho's powerful opera about a school shooting earns praise for its beauty and emotional impact, though one critic finds the aestheticization of such trauma troubling despite acknowledging its artistry.
